title: Hadwiger’s Coloring Conjecture and Its Odd-Minor Variant
exact_target: For every integer $t\geq1$, is every graph with no $K_{t+1}$ minor properly $t$-colorable? Is every graph with no odd $K_{t+1}$ minor properly $t$-colorable?
